question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Vertebrate animals that crawl on the ground
solution:
The correct answer is "**Reptiles**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Insects: **a small arthropod animal that has six legs and generally one or two pairs of wings.
 
• **Reptiles: **an animal that crawls or moves on its belly (such as a snake) or on small short legs (such as a lizard)
 
• **Mammals: **a warm-blooded vertebrate animal of a class that is distinguished by the possession of hair or fur, females that secrete milk for the nourishment of the young, and (typically) the birth of live young.
 
• **Amphibians: **an animal, such as a frog, that lives both on land and in water but must produce its eggs in water.
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**reptiles**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• ​**Example**: *Snake rescuer Vava Suresh has taken a pledge to save as many **reptiles **__as possible in his lifetime. *
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.
